info.name: NEXUS - Notification Service
info.description: User notification management: in-app notifications, unread counts, mark-as-read, and device/preference management for push notifications. Port: 8089

request.description:
Returns paginated notifications for the user, newest first.

Response 200: Page<Notification> {
  content: [{
    notificationId: String,
    userId: String,
    type: String (TRANSACTION_CONFIRMED | FRAUD_ALERT | KYC_RESULT | TRANSFER_RECEIVED | etc.),
    title: String,
    body: String,
    read: boolean,
    createdAt: Instant,
    readAt: Instant (null if unread)
  }],
  totalElements, totalPages, number, size
}

Returns the number of unread notifications from Redis cache.

Response 200: { unreadCount: long }

Mark a specific notification as read. Also decrements Redis unread count.

Response 200: No body

Mark all notifications as read via MongoDB bulk update. Resets Redis unread count to zero.

Response 200: No body

Get user's notification preferences. Creates and returns default preferences if not yet configured.

Response 200: UserNotificationPreferences {
  userId: String,
  language: String (es | en),
  timezone: String (e.g. America/Mexico_City),
  globalOptOut: boolean,
  inAppConfig: ChannelConfig { enabled: boolean },
  pushConfig: ChannelConfig { enabled: boolean, deviceArns: List<String> },
  emailConfig: ChannelConfig (optional),
  eventPreferences: Map<String, EventPref> {
    'FRAUD_ALERT': { enabled: true },  // Cannot be disabled
    'TRANSACTION_CONFIRMED': { enabled: boolean },
    'KYC_RESULT': { enabled: boolean },
    ...
  },
  updatedAt: Instant
}

Update notification preferences. FRAUD_ALERT channel cannot be disabled (regulatory requirement).

Validation: If eventPreferences.FRAUD_ALERT.enabled is false, returns 400 CANNOT_DISABLE_FRAUD_ALERTS.

Response 200: Updated UserNotificationPreferences
Response 400: { error: 'CANNOT_DISABLE_FRAUD_ALERTS', message: '...' }

Unregister a push notification device (e.g. on logout). Removes token from user's preferences and invalidates Redis cache.

Response 200: No body
